As a small nation in dire need of manpower it will come as no surprise that the best option is to either go Fascist to gain the 3% recruitable population from the focuses "Militarism" and "Military Youth". Or if you own the NSB DLC to go Communist and get the "Ideological Loyalty" spirit through the officer corps tab. With either of these routes you will have access to a reliable and consistent stream of manpower. Though if you want some A-historical spice, going communist will be more of a fun experience due to the historical links with Castro's government, despite the game being set 20 years before those events.

Focus wise, the best option is to go down the industrial branch until you have picked up the vital 2 civilian and 3 military factories, then I would suggest the "Naval Effort" focus to acquire 3 dockyards to begin the construction of a great Cuban fleet or "Political Effort" to grab the much needed political power so that you can start to hire advisors to modernize your country further or flip to Communist. Afterwards its your choice, but if you plan to go to war soon the best point to start work on is the Army branch of the focus tree - or you can make the flip to a radical ideology about now. *NOTE that because Cuba consists of only 1 state you cannot fire a civil war so you will only be able to peacefully transition to communism/fascism.

Like mentioned when discussing the focus tree, building a capable navy is essential for waring with your neighbors as to invade Central America or Hispaniola will require a fleet for naval invasions along with basic transport tech researched. Therefore, it may be a good idea to join a faction in order to access the "Technology Sharing" focus as well as completing the "Extra Research Slot" focus. Going after Venezuela may also be a good strategy as they have immense amounts of oil deposits scattered around the country.
Eventually, it may be a good idea to pick a fight with either Mexico or the US to access a very strong puppet and establish a Caribbean empire by rightfully annexing Florida.

After the Xinhai Revolution toppled the Qing dynasty and the last Qing troops were escorted out of Tibet, the new Republic of China apologized for the actions of the Qing and offered to restore the Dalai Lama's title. The Dalai Lama refused any Chinese title and declared himself ruler of an independent Tibet. In 1913, Tibet and Mongolia concluded a treaty of mutual recognition. For the next 36 years, the 13th Dalai Lama and the regents who succeeded him governed Tibet. During this time, Tibet fought Chinese warlords for control of the ethnically Tibetan areas in Xikang and Qinghai along the upper reaches of the Yangtze River. In 1914 the Tibetan government signed the Simla Accord with Britain, ceding the South Tibet region to British India. The Chinese government denounced the agreement as illegal.
When in the 1930s and 1940s the regents displayed negligence in affairs, the Kuomintang Government of the Republic of China took advantage of this to expand its reach into the territory.

Emerging with control over most of mainland China after the Chinese Civil War, the People's Republic of China invaded Tibet in 1950 and forcibly negotiated the Seventeen Point Agreement with the newly enthroned 14th Dalai Lama's government, affirming the People's Republic of China's sovereignty but granting the area nominal autonomy. Subsequently, on his journey into exile, the 14th Dalai Lama completely repudiated the agreement, which he has repeated on many occasions.

Tibet starts out with a weak industry and an almost non-existent military. Also, you're surrounded by much more powerful nations:
. In time, you will be able to take all of those nations.

First, begin by taking the Political Effort, which grants you much-needed Political Power . Begin researching Construction I and Basic Machine Tools. Use your Civilian Factories to build more Military Factories. Once that focus has been completed, spend that on the Fascist Demagogue, which will allow you to transit to Fascism and grant you the highly coveted 7% Recruitable Population.

After taking Political Effort, begin the Industrial Effort focus to upgrade your industry to more than just 2 Civilian Factories and 1 Military Factory. While that is happening, spend some of your remaining PP on the decision to Open Up Political Discourse . You probably won't have enough to do either Expand Civil Support or Discredit the Government , so save what little you have left.

With only two factories, your industrial upgrades will take a long time, and you will probably not finish until around 1938. That, however, is where your territorial expansion begins, first by a justification on the small nation of
, which will have around 1 division to defend itself from you.

While you're working on the justification, start going down the Nationalist Ethos side of the political focus tree. This will grant you a 7% Recruitable Population, something that is highly covered and useful for small nations as it boosts your manpower.

Once you finish justifying your war goal, send your two divisions down to the border with Bhutan and invade them. It shouldn't take more than a few days and you'll conquer them and take their one or two factories.

won't get you much manpower, unfortunately, so once you finish the Nationalism Focus of Tibet's generic focus tree, start the next focus, Militarism, which grants you 5% manpower and -10% damage to your garrisons by rebels in occupied nations.

At this point you should two Military Factories, the one you started with and the one you got from Bhutan. Set both to producing Basic Infantry Equipment, and begin justifying on your second minor neighbor, Nepal.

The difference between Nepal and Bhutan is that Nepal is mainly mountainous, which gives them a better area to defend. Also, they start out with 2 Mountaineer divisions. Unless you've trained another division already this will be a close and hard war. I would recommend stationing both divisions along the border but don't use battle plans.
Once the justification is finished, declare and then micromanage your troops until you can take the capital. Once the capital falls, you can annex Nepal into your empire.

You can try to do an uprising in Hungary, but you'll likely run out of time . You might be tempted to prepare it and launch it when Germany declares on the Soviet Union. Don't do that

In 1940, Italy will declare on Greece. With no Bulgaria, no direct land route from Rome to Greece, British naval dominance in the Med, and only a narrow mountainous border between Albania and Greece, Italy will quickly get stuck. Build up an army, build some forts along the border with Germany and Hungary.

In 1941, Germany will declare on the Soviet Union. By then, Italy will be exhausted and low on equipment, a big chunk of its army will be stuck in Albania with low supply. You'll have two full armies, your northern flank will be very difficult to breach , and the Soviet Union will help you defend the long border with Hungary. A hard push and some encirclements should topple Mussolini and give you Regno Del Sud as a puppet.

With the Axis down from five to two members and with Germany denied Austrian industry, Germany should be relatively easy to take down, and your participation score may be as much as 25%, more than enough to demand all of Italy and Hungary.

After the peace conference, you reduce Italian autonomy to zero to annex it. With any luck, Greece leaves the Allies and you can pull the same peasant uprising trick, easily capitulating them. If not, it should not be too difficult to occupy them with the help of the Soviet Union .

It's no secret that Dalmatia starts in a stuck position with no resources and army, but given some smart moves and cheese you should be able to form a pretty formidable Dalmatia, given some time, effort, and luck. It comes with compensation of 2 factories, 1 civilian factory and naval factory. Select Yugoslavia, and by focus release Dalmatia and take it from

Unlike Herzegovina, Dalmatia doesnt possess a tag of its own. Instead it comes with a civil war tag, and dependent by Yugoslav national focus. Although by console commands, and in Yugoslavia fragmented rule, all you have to do is to bring Yugoslavia from the dead with console commands. Annex Croatia, and with console commands again take the Devolved Croatia focus that allegedly releases them both with infantry units.

Now, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a fascist advisor. Yes, I know, going fascist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for fascist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent fascist support, so hold a referendum to become Independent State of Dalmatia. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids. Otherwise, if your manpower is still an issue you can go communist to get to the weekly manpower army experience.

By now you should have a total of 7 or 8 factories- 5 civilian and 3 military. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.

At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start justifying on Montenegro. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Should you declare on Bosnia, Croatia, or god forbid, Serbia and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources and sea access for marine trade.

Tip: If you let independent Dalmatia be controlled by an AI, it will annex Croatia by referendum if they share the same ideology. Dalmatia that way will gain additional cores and as well as a bigger army, and inheriting claims from Croatia itself.

consist of a set of states.
A map of state ID numbers.
A map showing blank states.

Ownership over territory is determined at the state level. Control over both the resources and state-wide construction of a state is determined by the plurality controller of a state, meaning the country that controls the most victory points. Each province in a state is worth 0.1
victory points. Some provinces have additional victory points.

These are all named and marked with small squares , pentagons , circles , or stars on the map and their additional victory points are displayed in the tooltip when hovering over them. Resistance is computed at the state level.
States can be either core states or colony states. Cores are considered an integral part of the country, and the inhabitants are fully available for military service. Nations get a
penalty to manpower in colony states, and have half as many building slots available as in a core state.

Nations may justify war goals against foreign-owned core states in half the time and for half the political power as on other states. Only victory points in core states count when determining if a country will capitulate. When a nation controls a non-core state, that state will generate 抵抗度.
Unlike other Paradox games, there is normally no way for countries to gain cores. You can lose cores if you release/return territory of a country.
Some country-specific events and national focuses, like the Anschluss event for
for central America, will grant cores. As of the 抵抗运动 expansion, there is an exception to this rule, with
无政府主义西班牙 able to core any state with enough compliance with the Global Defense Council focus.
Construction can be divided into three categories: state buildings, shared buildings and province buildings.
State buildings are state-wide and every state can reach the same maximum level for each building.
Infrastructure, airbases, anti-air and radar stations belong to this category.
Shared buildings are also state-wide, but the amount that can be built is limited to the number of free slots. Once all slots are occupied, no more shared buildings can be built.
Factories, dockyards, synthetic refineries, fuel silos, rocket sites, and nuclear reactors belong to this category
Province buildings are built per-province, their maximum levels depend on the type of building.
Naval bases, forts and supply hubs belong to this category.

Resources for production are generated at the state level. The majority controller will have a certain amount of the resources of a state added to their resource pool depending on their occupation policy.
A map of state populations.
A state's total population is shown in its info panel. The tooltip contains its recruitable population and cap , civilian population and cap and monthly growth numbers.
The population in a state is tracked by five numbers.

is the population the state starts with; it is shown on the state's info panel. Monthly population growth is based on it and the total never declines. The game's duration usually spans less than a generation, so all inhabitants that could enter military service are already born at the start of the game.
is available for the controlling country to use in military service. Recruitable population gets reduced as
is used in the military, not just after taking casualties.
is a fraction of the total population that limits the recruitable population. For how the fraction is calculated, see
is the portion of the population that is not available for military service.
is a fraction of the total population that limits the civilian population. It is the total population minus the recruitable population cap.

Changes in the effective recruitable population ratio can cause one of the two population counts to overflow. In this case population is transferred to the other population type. For example, if a country raises its recruitment law, the civilian population cap will go down over time , which causes some civilian population to be transferred to recruitable population. Conversely, if a state is captured by a country that does not have a core on it, the recruitable ratio will be massively reduced and might cause recruitable population to transfer back to civilian population.
The state's total population grows by

at the start of every month. The increase in population is distributed between recruitable and the civilian population by the recruitable ratio. Both increases are always at least one person respectively.

The state category usually decides on the amount of shared building slots available to use. The category for any state is decided at the game's start and it isn't generally possible to change, however certain countries have content allowing them to upgrade the state category of certain states.

As Jordan was a territory administered by Britain until 1946, it is as such a part of the British Empire as a playable Colony in both the 1936 and 1939 start dates. If Britain follows with the Revisit Colonial Policy, which starts the gradual release of Britain's territories. For Jordan it will become quickly independent. During the time one is waiting for this to happen though you may wish to develop Jordan by focusing on the navy part and possibly lend leasing towards the overlord. Additionally if you wish to conquer later on Palestine, Kuwait, or any other British Arabian territories you may want to develop these provinces as well so you don't have to do so later on as Jordan with its far smaller industrial/economic base.

Alternatives to this option include also taking Jordan as another nation in a peace deal so that you may release it through the menu options not available to Britain. Another option is when setting up your game choosing the Decolonize Asia menu option so that all middle eastern and Asian territories are released as independent nations right at the start in 1936. For this last option however it is important to note you will not be able to earn any achievements.

But fortunately as a Colony, Jordan possesses the ability to make haste on its independence. Build up naval bases and produce convoys in order to lend them to Britain in order to secure the independence quickly.

For the first two above given options how the player chooses to expand will be influenced by who you border which will not always be completely predicable. However, there are several things which will always be the same and which must be carefully managed in order to expand. Jordan has only one province which means you start out with a tiny or non-existent industrial base, and a very small population. It is strongly advisable that one flips either communist or Fascist to take advantage of their respective options to boost manpower. Additionally changing your politics will allow you to join a larger faction such as the Axis or Comintern which will be needed if you wish to take any nearby British or French territories.

An interesting side note is Jordan is one of the few nations in game with a coastline, albeit a tiny one on the red sea, but with NO NAVAL BASES. This means if you wish to build a small navy and do naval invasions of Saudi Arabia, Yemen or Oman for example you will first need to build a base. It does not matter if you have dockyards through the focus tree as you will still need a base to deploy naval units to. Even if one chooses to not use Jordan's small manpower on a navy it is still advisable to build a base as this will open up more possible trading partners and allow members of your faction send units to station on your territory .

The history of the Kaiserreich timeline is the same as our timeline until 1917, when the Kaiser ultimately decides not to restart unrestricted submarine warfare. Without the help of the United States, the French military is unable to push the Germans back, eventually collapsing under a German offensive and capitulating to the Germans. As the Central Powers and the Entente were now either unwilling or unable to destroy the other, the Central Powers first divided the spoils of war, then offered a "Peace with Honour" to the Entente, ending the Weltkrieg on November 11, 1921.

After fighting a brutal seven-year war with nothing to show for it, both France and Great Britain fall to syndicalist rebellions. The Commune of France and the Union of Britain are formed, while the exiled governments escape to North Africa and Canada respectively. When Britain falls, some territories such as Gibraltar, Cyprus, and Malta are seized by other countries. Australia and New Zealand form the Australasian Confederation. India splits into three: the loyalist Dominion of India in the west, syndicalist Bharatiyan Commune in the east, and independent Princely Federation in the South. South Africa stays loyal but later votes to leave the Entente. The various island colonies of Britain and France join to form the Caribbean Federation.

In the decades since the Weltkrieg, the world has been an unstable and violent place. The Russian socialist revolution is crushed by the White Russians with the help of German troops. However, during the revolution, a number of new states have formed or were created. These include the United Baltic Duchy, Lithuania, White Ruthenia, the Kingdom of Ukraine, the Don-Kuban Union, the Alash Autonomy, and Transamur. China has been split into multiple pieces as well. There is the reformed Qing Empire, the Fengtian Government, the League Of Eight Provinces, the Legation Cities, the Ma, and Yunnan Cliques, Shangqing, and Tibet. Italy is split into various states, but following a French-backed Syndicalist uprising in the north which forms the Socialist Republic of Italy, the Pope seizes land surrounding Rome, and Republicans declare their own state in the northeast. As a result, the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies was the only one of the balkanized Italian states to remain, and the former ruling House of Savoy fled to Sardinia.

In the Americas, Woodrow Wilson does not run for a second term, and the Republican Leonard Wood is elected as president and is reelected before dying in his second term. He is succeeded by Herbert Hoover, who presides over the 1929 crash of the New York Stock Exchange and the start of the Great Depression. The Great Depression only affects the Americas, as most of the world now revolves around the Berlin Stock Exchange. The Mexican government is overthrown by syndicalist Zapatistas. A syndicalist Centroamerica causes its neighbors in Central America to form the United Provinces. Argentina wins a war against Bolivia and Brazil and annexes Paraguay and Uruguay to form the Federation of La Plata.
Events during the early game
Black Monday - The 1936 of the Berlin Stock Exchange triggers a global economic depression, devastating Germany's economy and rippling across the entire Weltkrieg-torn world.

Second American Civil War - Following the controversial 1936 election, the United States descends into chaos as the Workers' Congress of America, the American Union State, and the Pacific States of America each break away in response to federal collapse, military overreach, or populist revolt.

Spanish Civil War - The Iberian Peninsula fractures as competing visions for Spain’s future clash: Republican loyalists, the anarcho-syndicalist CNT-FAI, and the traditionalist Carlists all take up arms against the embattled monarchy or each other, depending on how early conflicts unfold.

Collapse of the League of Eight Provinces - Upon the death of Sun Chuanfang, the fragile unity of the LEP disintegrates. Warlordism returns to Southern China, with rival cliques, reformists, and the KMT vying for control over the future of the Chinese heartland.

The Second Weldkrieg, Starts with a War between Syndicalist France and Germany causes a war between The 3rd International and the Reichpakt, which leads to a war between the following faction: The 3rd International is at war with the Reichpakt and the Entente. The Reichpakt is at war with the 3rd International, The Moscow accords, and the Entente. The Entente is at war with The 3rd International and the Reichpakt. The Moscow Accords are at war with the Reichpakt.

It's no secret that Vojvodina starts in a stuck position with no resources and factories, but given some smart moves and cheese you should be able to form a pretty formidable Vojvodina, given some time, effort, and luck. It comes with compensation of oil if given focus by Yugoslavia. Select Yugoslavia, and by focus release Vojvodina and take it from

Unlike Herzegovina, Vojvodina doesnt possess a tag of its own. Instead it comes with a civil war tag, and dependent by Yugoslav national focus. Although by console commands, and in Yugoslavia fragmented rule, all you have to do is to bring Yugoslavia from the dead with console commands. Select and own Vojvodina from Serbia, and with console commands again take the 斯拉夫特兰西瓦尼亚自治 focus that allegedly releases it with infantry units.

Now, the first thing you should do is take the first Political focus, which will give you 120 political power, plus the 70 you have already accumulated. Use this to get a fascist advisor. Yes, I know, going fascist is the go-to strategy for basically every minor, but if it works, it works. While you wait for fascist support to tick up, take some industrial focuses to get some free factories. Grab the two free civilian factories first, then get the three military factories. By this time you should be above fifty percent fascist support, so hold a referendum to become Syrmian Empire. Use your excess political power to get war economy, and if you have any extra left, get some Improved Worker Conditions or Anti-Communist/Democratic raids. Otherwise, if your manpower is still an issue you can go communist to get to the weekly manpower army experience.

By now you should have a total of 6 or 7 factories- 4 civilian and 3 military. One of your civilian factories will be used for consumer goods, so use the remaining one to either build some more civs or trade for some steel. Use one of your 3 military factories to produce artillery, and use the other 2 to build guns. Set some factories to build support equipment as well once you get some more mils.

At this point, you should've flipped fascist already, so start justifying on Croatia. At the same time start working on the political focuses. Make a template of one cavalry unit, and spam it out. You should also have a fair amount of political power at this point, so take some stability-increasing decisions. Should you declare on Bosnia, Montenegro, or god forbid, Serbia and win against them each other can give you enough expansion and access to some valuable resources and sea access for marine trade.

Tip: If you let independent Vojvodina be controlled by an AI, it will annex Hungary by referendum if they share the same ideology. Vojvodina that way will gain additional cores and as well as a bigger army, and inheriting claims from Hungary itself.

With the introduction of special projects in
, all armor technologies now also generate land warfare breakthrough progress while being researched. Armor technologies are also particularly intertwined with the
The tank has proven itself a powerful weapon in the Great War. While development has slowed in the intervening years, it is no doubt going to play a major role in the wars to come.

Technological advances have made the designs of the immediate post-war period effectively obsolete. The modern battlefield requires a new, clean design incorporating advances in metallurgy and interior layout.
A further iteration based on the experiences gained with previous light tanks, this chassis allows for better reliability and maintenance.

With medium tanks increasingly taking center stage in the fight, light tanks have largely been relegated to supporting roles. A new chassis design is needed that takes the needs of these roles into account.

Cosmetic tags are a feature used to change the cosmetic appearance of a country.

Unlike regular tags, cosmetic tags do not require any definition to work and are not limited to 3 letters. A cosmetic tag changes the cosmetic aspects of the country that has it. In debug mode, the name of the cosmetic tag is shown when hovering over the country's flag in the politics or diplomacy view. The country may only have at most one cosmetic tag, setting a new one will remove the previous one.

Most commonly, this is used to change the flag, name, and/or the colour of the country as it appears on the map, but it may also be used to change other information, such as the names and portraits of randomly-generated characters or entities used for the troop models. If a cosmetic tag doesn't change the appearance of a cosmetic aspect, it will remain unchanged from the default after the country gets it. The content for cosmetic tags is nearly always added identically to base cosmetic content, with the country tag replaced with the cosmetic tag.

Flags are added in for cosmetic tags the same way as they would be added for the base appearance of countries: three 32-bit TGA-file flags with no RLE encoding with the bottom-left origin point are added into
/Hearts of Iron IV/gfx/flags
and its subfolders and their usage is based off the filename.

The fallback does not have priority over an ideology-specific base country flag.

To ensure the safety of convoys, the destroyers of the Great War must be repurposed and developed. Arming vessels with more torpedoes will allow more opportunities to engage.
Longer torpedo range and faster reload speeds, along with new types of armaments such as anti-air turrets, will allow our destroyers to remain efficient and versatile.

The modern destroyer must be fitted with a variety of different detection technologies, new depth charge deployment systems and be built at a larger scale than their predecessors.
Maneuverable light cruisers that can maintain a high speed will continue to be useful for scouting missions.
Post-war treaties put restrictions on cruisers, but well-armed light vessels can be developed while remaining within these limits.
Now skirting the limits of treaties, larger and more heavily armored cruisers can be built, still with light enough weaponry to be classified as light cruisers.
Tactically employed to protect larger ships, the modern generation of light cruisers can shake off most past restrictions and be better armed to handle aerial attacks.
The Washington Naval Treaty was set up to prevent an arms race in cruisers, among other ships, but this seems inevitable. By keeping armor light, the weapons load can be increased.
Despite new efforts at treaties, refitting lighter cruisers with heavier weaponry remains efficient, although armor is still limited.

As restrictions are increasingly ignored worldwide, more balanced heavy cruiser designs with more priority on armor can be built. Better anti-air guns allow these ships to cooperate in naval air warfare.
Upscaled, longer and heavier designs with rapid-fire armaments are features in these final stages of heavy cruiser development.
The post-war battlecruiser arms race resulted in severely heavily armed designs, sacrificing armor for speed compared to battleship.
Rebuilt and repurposed battlecruisers continue to outrun even modern battleship designs by lighter protection, but have developed better systems for fire control, detection and aerial defenses.

Considered by some to be a relic of a bygone era of naval warfare, by others as the most impressive ships ever built, no one can deny that these remnants of the battleship arms race constitute some of the most heavily armed and armored vessels ever built.
With improved stability and range, a new generation of battleships improve upon previous designs while remaining within limits stipulated by naval treaties.

Thicker armor, stronger engines, a battery of high-caliber guns and improved anti-air capabilities can allow battleships to remain relevant, if correctly employed, in a world where naval warfare is increasingly dominated by aerial support.
As the world sees what may be the last major battleship confrontations, the importance of heavy armaments and anti-air turrets is greater than ever.
An improvement on our earlier super heavy design with stronger weapons and improved fire control systems.
Many military theorists believe that naval aviation is the future. Converting old capital ships and ocean liners to carry aircraft will be the first step towards utilizing these new doctrines.
As work begins on the first keel-up carrier designs, we must ensure that these ships have the range and speed to keep up with the rest of our navy, while respecting the post-war naval treaties.
Improved construction methods and more specialized systems like deck edge elevators allow these carriers to transport more planes more efficiently.
With many naval treaties now increasingly ignored, we can proceed to build carriers capable of transporting more planes than ever to secure air superiority cover.

Sudetenland German Free Corps was a paramilitary organization founded on 17 September 1938 in Germany on direct order of Adolf Hitler. The organization was composed mainly of ethnic German citizens of Czechoslovakia with pro-Nazi sympathies who were sheltered, trained and equipped by the German army and who conducted cross-border terrorist operations into Czechoslovak territory from 1938 to 1939. They played a role in destabilizing Czechoslovakia and facilitating the annexation of the Sudetenland into the Third Reich under Nazi Germany.

The increasing aggressiveness of Hitler prompted the Czechoslovak military to start to build extensive border fortifications in 1936 to defend the troubled border region. Immediately after the Anschluss of Austria into the German Reich in March 1938, Hitler made himself the advocate of ethnic Germans living in Czechoslovakia, which triggered the Sudeten Crisis. The following month, Sudeten Nazis, led by Konrad Henlein, agitated for autonomy. On 24 April 1938, the SdP proclaimed the Karlsbader Programm, which demanded in eight points the complete equality between the Sudeten Germans and the Czech people. The government accepted those claims on 30 June 1938.

The Sudetenland was assigned to Germany between 1 and 10 October 1938. The Czech part of Czechoslovakia was subsequently invaded by Germany in March 1939, with a portion being annexed and the remainder turned into the Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia. The Slovak part declared its independence from Czechoslovakia and became the Slovak Republic , a satellite state allied to Germany.

As Indonesia or the Philippines, form Maphilindo and control all Indian core states.

To get the "INS_maphilindo" tag, you need to take the "Invite the Philippines" decision. This decision is only available by controlling all starting states of the Philippines while the Philippines still exist but aren't your subject.
To get "PHI_maphilindo_flag" you need to take the "Form Maphilindo" decision, which requires controlling all Malayan and Indonesian states.

This is likely most easily done with the Hispanic Empire path for the Philippines - They can potentially receive all of Latin America and Spain for free with cores, and you get their entire navies for free. The Dutch East Indies are arguably stronger, but it takes longer to get to a point where you can declare war & the method to get the tag properly is more awkward. Both Historical and Ahistorical mode have benefits and drawbacks - Historical is consistent, but will require you to annex the US if you don't kill the UK by 1940. Ahistorical can potentially keep the US out of the allies and get an early independent India, but is much buggier and can potentially lead to even worse superfactions to deal with .

The general path in both Historical and Ahistorical is the same - as the Philippines, rush down the monarchist path as fast as possible up to the war for independence. If you're lucky, America will just give you independence without having to do the war - otherwise reset since its relatively early. After independence, just keep allying and attempting to annex as many Hispanic nations as possible, ideally the ones with the most manpower or factories first . These annexations can actually be savescummed even in ironman mode, but the most critical one is Spain - if they reject annexation/allying, you need to reset or savescum. From here, strategy is dependent on circumstances & preference. If playing on historical mode, you should attempt to Sealion the UK with the Axis - you can join the faction for their assistance flooding troops in after landing/paradropping, but defeating the UK is significantly harder in historical now as a minor nation without tanks or air . If you can't kill the UK in historical before the US joins the allies or a dominion becomes a major, you have to defeat them as well. Even if you can kill the UK, you need to have gained enough warscore to annex both the Indian and Malaysian & Indonesian states required for the achievement . As of 1.19.1 not all Indonesian states are required for the "Form Maphilindo" decision, so keep that in mind for the peace deal. Do the "Malayo-Polynesia" focus to get claims on Malaysia and Indonesia and therefore will be cheaper in the peace deal. Also note that the achievement description is misleading, you need specifically the Indian states from the achievement requirements.

Alternatively, an ideal ahistorical mode can lead to an early independent India, which you can simply invade and annex . After this, you just need to occupy certain Indonesian/Malaysian states to be able to click the decision, which is a lot easier since it doesn't require a peace deal. Another ahistorical setup that may be easier to manipulate is just one without America in the Allies, which can arise from the communist/democratic/nonaligned Japanese paths. In this scenario, you just need to get strong enough to beat the UK, which allows for more buildup time. Alternatively to all of the above, you can just invade America early after annexing/allying Mexico, which would give you all the resources you need to beat Britain. However, it's hard to get a wargoal on them without them joining the allies anyway, and it's a major detour if you want to actually get the achievement in a reasonable amount of time.

To get the achievement playing as DEI on historical, you'll have to first become independent as democratic Republic of Indonesia, producing some transport planes and support equipment in the process. You can join Allies when Germany attacks Benelux, then ask UK for Malay provinces and then US for Philippines. Start justifying on Siam as early as possible, aiming to declare war and capitulate it before Japan's pressure attempt in mid-1941. Marines landing in Bangkok and paradrops from Burma into other cities will help a lot. With annexed Malay, Philippines and capitulated Siam you'll have a decent, albeit outdated, fleet. You can release puppet Republic of Thailand after Japan gets Indochina from France. From here two main goals are to protect outer islands as much as possible from Japan's marine landings to preserve factories and prepare for Sea Lion. What worked for me was staying in Allies, while declaring on Soviet Union, asking Germany for military access and prepare landings from Norway to somewhere around Scottish border. At some point, when naval dominance looks okay and divisions are ready, leave allies, join Axis , invade UK. It might be intense , since UK is now more prepared to repel the invaders, but you can weather the initial attacks in the mountains and then push back. To ramp up the score required to take all India, you can invade it from Ceylon even with 2nd grade troops and quickly cover vast territories.

The Free City of Danzig was a city-state under the protection and oversight of the League of Nations between 1920 and 1939, consisting of the Baltic Sea port of Danzig and nearly 200 other small localities in the surrounding areas. The polity was created on 15 November 1920 in accordance with the terms of Article 100 of the 1919 Treaty of Versailles after the end of World War I.

Although predominantly German-populated, the territory was bound by the imposed union with Poland covering foreign policy, defence, customs, railways and post, but remained distinct from both the post-war German Republic and the newly independent Polish Republic. In addition, Poland was given certain rights pertaining to port facilities in the city.
The Free City of Danzig was the centre of the 1939 crisis that led to World War II breaking out in Europe.

On 1 September 1939, the day of the German invasion of the Free City of Danzig, Forster signed a law declaring the Free City to be incorporated into Germany. On the same day, Hitler signed a law declaring the law signed by Forster to be German law and the Free City of Danzig was officially incorporated into Germany.

At the Yalta Conference in February 1945, the Allies agreed that the city would become part of Poland. No formal treaty has ever altered the status of the Free City of Danzig, and its incorporation into Poland has rested upon the general acquiescence of the international community. Subsequently, several groups proclaimed they represented the Free City of Danzig Government in Exile, a continuation of the state.

The Imperial Influence system is set up as a points system. In 1936, the army starts with 20 points, the navy starts with 15 points, the Zaibatsu start with 15 points, and the Civic Faction starts with 10 points.
There are four tiers of influence. From the lowest tier to the highest: Subdued, Meddling, Influential and Dominating. There can only be one Dominating faction at a time.
Generally, for small influence increases, the faction gains 5 points. For large influence increases, the faction gains 10 points.
For a small increase, the game checks if the faction level is less than the variable

which is 40 points. Then, for each tier below Dominating, the game checks if the faction's points are below a certain number. If it's below, it only gains 5 points. Otherwise, it increases in tier and then gains the points. The values required for an increase in tiers is as follows: Subdued to Meddling requires 5 points, Meddling to Influential requires 20 points, Influential to Dominating requires 35 points. Then if there is a faction that is already Dominating, it will then be demoted to Influential and will be set to 35 points.

For a large increase, the game does a similar check as the small increase, however the points required to increase tiers are different. Subdued to Meddling will automatically go up, Meddling to Influential requires 15 points, Influential to Dominating requires 30 points. It will then gain 10 points. Similarly, if there is a faction that is already Dominating, it will then be demoted to Influential and will be set to 35 points.
For a small decrease, the game checks if the faction level is less than the variable

which is 0 points. Then, for each tier above Subdued, the game checks if the faction's points are above a certain number. if it is above, it only loses 5 points. Otherwise, it decreases in tier and then loses the points. The values required for a decrease in tiers is as follows: Dominating to Influential requires 44 points, Influential to Meddling requires 29 points, Meddling to Subdued requires 14 points.
For a large decrease, the game checks if the faction level is more than the variable

which is 9 points. If it is below 9 points, it only loses 5 points. If it is above 9 points, for each tier above Subdued, the game checks if the faction's points are above a certain number. If it is not above, it then gets demoted if it is not above a certain point limit. The values required for a decrease in tiers is as follows: Dominating to Influential requires 49 points, Influential to Meddling requires 34 points, Meddling to Subdued requires 19 points. It then loses 10 points.

For the pre-1.17 doctrine system, see a previous version of this page.
The Big Gun Club - A traditionalist focus on naval artillery and heavy armor, to overwhelm the enemy fleet and drown them in a storm of steel.
Privateers for the modern age - An indirect approach to naval warfare focused on strangling maritime trade, starving the enemy of resources they need to fight the war.
Hit hard, hit first - The new technologies of naval aviation offer the intriguing possibility of striking the enemy from beyond the horizon, before he knows he is fighting.
Hunt dispersed - strike in unison. Our submarines can spread out to cover vast stretches of ocean, then signal each other to converge when suitable prey is spotted.
Mass integration of submarines in to the main battle fleet, to provide reconnaissance and ambush enemy ships during a general engagement.
The proper role of the submarine in modern war is to avoid the distraction of lesser prey, and focus on sinking enemy capital ships above all else.
Small submarines operating close to shore can prove a consistent thorn in the side of a would-be invader.
With their stealth and agility, submarines are an ideal platform from which to seed the sea lanes with mines and restrict enemy freedom of movement.
When our fleets operate at extreme ranges our submarines need to be able to follow, in order to provide full support to our surface task forces.
The chief duty of light ships is to secure the maritime trade upon which all our war efforts depend. Everything else is secondary.
Screening forces lack the firepower of capital ships, but using speed as armor, they can provide valuable service even in a pitched naval battle.
While enemy submarines threaten to strangle our war economy, well-organized and aggressive destroyer escorts can turn the hunter into the hunted.
An emphasis on aggressive, daring destroyer torpedo attacks in favor of defensive screening, to wear down the enemy battleline before the main engagement.
Light cruisers lack the staying power to stand in the line of battle, but they can be crammed with high-angle weapons and provide powerful AA protection for the fleet.
Improvements to the training and organization of our support ship apparatus will indirectly but dramatically strengthen our main battle fleet.
A doctrinal concept emphasizing swarms of small ships, torpedo strikes, and indirect commerce warfare as an antidote to the old notion of a big gun slugging match on the high seas.
Cheap fast attack craft armed with torpedos are a powerful tool against a traditional battle fleet of heavy ships, particularly in coastal waters where they can strike from ambush.
The carrier is rapidly eclipsing the battleship as the chief naval weapon of our age. Our fleets should be centered around them.
A carrier deck is the most expensive piece of real estate on Earth. No effort must be spared in eking out the maximum amount of possible air power from it.
Small, economical escort carriers grant our convoys defensive air cover all the way to their destination. No enemy submarine may strike with impunity.
With reconnaissance, air superiority, and strike capability all in one package, carriers are an invaluable Jack-of-all-trades tool in the hands of the task force commander.
Just as much as on land, success in naval combat depends on concentrating as much striking power as possible at the single decisive point. Division breeds defeat.
Mastery from a specific set of units:
Carriers are powerful, but vulnerable in direct combat. For them to deliver their payloads and contribute to victory, they must first be survivable.
With our grand fleet in line astern and broadsides roaring, we will demonstrate that big guns still rule the waves.
In a world where everyone has big guns, fast capital ships offer the ability to pick fights we want, and run from ones we don't.
Convoy escorts primarily focus on anti-submarine defense. Imagine their shock when a fully-armed capital ship appears in their midst, like a wolf among sheep.
Smaller warships, prioritizing firepower over range and operating close to friendly shores, can prove a considerable deterrent to a hostile fleet.
Once the enemy battle fleet is neutralized, our heavy naval guns are free to turn their wrath on land targets, to support our troops ashore.
Battleships offer unrivaled opportunity for deck armaments. Equipping them to target enemy aircraft should be a priority to keep the skies clear for our task forces.

For the pre-1.17 doctrine system, see a previous version of this page.
Mass bombing of factories, refineries, and transport infrastructure deep in the enemy's hinterland, to cut off his warmaking potential at the source.
Techniques and training for close army-air force cooperation, with air strikes acting as flying artillery to blast a path for fast-moving ground operations.
Gaining and maintaining air superiority, as a prerequisite for domination of the battlespace by general purpose medium bombers carrying out operational strikes.
In order to prosecute the war effectively, our industry and infrastructure must be shielded from strategic bombardment at any cost.
For our strike aircraft to operate with impunity, it is necessary that they be closely supported by fighters to sweep the skies of hostile aircraft.
When not needed to combat enemy aircraft, our fighters can switch focus to strikes on ground targets to assist the army.
A focus on offensive air-to-air combat tactics designed to seize control of the skies.
Almost uniquely in modern warfare, a fighter pilot fights alone. We must ensure the individual excellence of every pilot.
Air power is the dominant weapon of the age, and the aircraft carrier allows its devastating striking potential to have a global reach.
A generalist approach to strike prioritization, engaging targets of opportunity from the front line all the way out to operational depth.
Air strikes on front line targets during an active land battle exposes aircraft to ground fire and can be risky for friendly troops, but the effects at the sharp end are dramatic.
With their speed and range, our strike craft can perform versatile double-duty supporting the army on land, or attacking enemy vessels at sea.
Almost all the world's industry and warmaking potential is within airstrike range of a coastline. Our carriers can put air power in the enemy's backyard.
Carrier aircraft must run a gauntlet of enemy fighters and AA to deliver their payloads. Our training will emphasize survivability and tenacity in pressing home the attack.
A few torpedos can be evaded. Dozens of them all at once can lay the most hardened target low through sheer volume.
Although their lack of agility can be a drawback against lighter aircraft, heavy fighters can carry destructive anti-bomber firepower.
Unescorted daylight bombing of the enemy homeland will incur ruinous losses. We need fighters with the range to accompany our bombers all the way there, and all the way back.
A doctrine focused on dominating the operational battle area via persistent attacks by highly survivable medium aircraft.
A fleet of light bombers raining devastation from the sky upon hostile strong points, paving the way for the advance of our own troops.
Freed from the risk of hitting friendly troops, our bomber fleet can range unhindered in the enemy's rear areas, sowing havoc and aiding the fighting fronts indirectly.
The oldest form of military aviation is reconnaissance. In this, as in every age, knowing where the enemy is and what he is up to can be more powerful than any weapon.
Contrary to Douhet, the bomber does not, in fact, always get through. Flying at night reduces our accuracy, but vastly improves the survival rate of our planes and crews.
Trying to strike point targets from 30,000 feet is generally a waste of bombs. Flying in line abreast and creating a wide lane of destruction is a more reliable way to hit...something.
With the right equipment and training, there is no target too deep in the enemy's hinterland to be struck. The enemy will come to know that no place is safe from our bombs.
Large groups of bombers, flying in close formation and with heavy defensive armament, can force any attacking fighter to brave the fire of dozens of guns at once.
Traditional sea-level means of coastal defense are manpower-intensive and inefficient. Aerial mobility means we can keep an eye on friendly shores and punish any would-be invader.
The range of modern aircraft allows for naval search and strike missions against enemy assets well before they threaten our coasts.
The size and carrying capacity of large airframes gives them an unparalleled ability to carry a wide variety of mission-specific equipment for any military situation.

The Launcher for Hoi4. Items 1 through 7 are as follows: 1) game version and checksum 2) video display button 3) clear user directory button 4) game play button 5) create account button 6) downloadable content tab 7) mods tab. Note that the DLC tab is currently open.

Video display button - Clicking the gear icon opens the video display menu. This menu has 3 dropdown menus; Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. The Display Mode allows three choices: Fullscreen, Windowed, and Borderless. Fullscreen is recommended because Windowed and Borderless modes on some systems have been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game . The Resolution allows a multitude of choices such as 1600x1024, 1680x1050, etc. Matching the game's resolution to the monitor's native resolution usually gives the optimum viewing experience. The Refresh Rate should also be set to match the monitor, if possible. The 60 Hz selection is recommended because it is quite common and the 50 Hz selection has been known to cause launch issues such as blackscreens and failure to launch the game.

This graphic has a vertical arrow pointing to the video display button represented by the gear icon. Clicking the "gear icon" will open the video display menu revealing 3 dropdown menus; one menu each for Display Mode, Resolution, and Refresh Rate. Clicking on each small, inverted, green triangle will open a menu for choosing your video preference. The graphic shows that Fullscreen, 1920x1080, and 60 Hz have been selected.
Clear user directory button - Clicking on this button will clear your HOI4 user directory. Only click on this button if you are experiencing game crashes. Reference the Tooltip in the graphic.

Mods tab - Clicking on the Mods tab will show a pulldown menu capable of revealing all of the mods that have been downloaded for the game. Clicking an item will place a green check mark

next to the item indicating that it has been selected for inclusion in the game. No check mark indicates that the item was not selected for the game. The graphic shows that the mods "Coloured Buttons" and "More Division Icons" have been selected. Mods can be downloaded from the Steam Workshop. Be aware that some mods will deactivate the ability to get achievements during gameplay and that some mods are not updated for the latest version of the game which can lead to a system crash. Reading the author's information about their mod will usually indicate if the mod is compatible with achievements and what version of HOI4 that their mod has been updated to.

Artillery refers to large-caliber weapons, such as cannons and howitzers that are operated by crews, which can project munitions far beyond the effective range of personal weapons.
Lessons learned in the development of different types of artillery can be cross-applied to the design of other pieces.
New howitzer designs, taking advantage of new hydraulic recoil devices and longer barrels.
Upgrading old pieces can only get us so far. New howitzer designs will be needed, taking advantage of new hydraulic recoil devices and longer barrels.
Specialized vehicles designed to transport and support super-heavy howitzers, ensuring mobility and easiness of battlefield deployment.
Super-Heavy Howitzer, Self-Propelled Super-Heavy Howitzer:
Enhanced projectiles for super-heavy howitzers, designed to extend range and improve impact through rocket propulsion.
Super-Heavy Howitzer, Self-Propelled Super-Heavy Howitzer:
To enable heavier guns on lighter carriages, muzzle brakes can be included in howitzer designs.
Light-weight artillery capable of being broken down for transport, making it possible to bring artillery support to areas previously difficult to reach.
Artillery designs with lower silhouettes will be more difficult for the enemy to target.
Anti-air artillery is primarily designed to shoot down hostile planes, although the rapid fire cannons can also be effective against ground targets.
With faster reloading mechanisms, anti-air guns carrying large rounds can still maintain necessary firing rates.
Anti-air guns with longer cartridges and barrels, able to target high-flying aircraft.

As radar systems improve, employing radar direction of anti-aircraft guns becomes more viable. Keeping up with this technology will allow us to make some of the most accurate anti-air systems available.
Combining modern systems of radar, computerization and autoloaders will be necessary to react quickly against faster aircraft.
An advanced mobile flak gun with greater reach and firing capacity, to combat even the fastest and highest-flying enemy aircraft.
By using various Shock-Hardening Techniques, and utilizing stress equalizers for our components, we lowered the rate of premature detonations, making our projectiles more reliable and effective
With adapting Variable Time Fuze Shells - we have made our field artillery devastating against our opponents. Shells explode before reaching the ground, thus creating much bigger kill-zone.
Artillery specialized in defeating armored targets like Tanks, it generally fires armor piercing shells.
The importance of effective anti-tank weapons was established in the Great War. Introducing a new generation of these weapons will be necessary to combat modern tank designs.
Larger caliber guns to combat heavier tanks with sloped armor.
HEAT rounds can be used in anti-tank artillery to make up for limited muzzle velocity.
New versatile anti-tank guns employing armored-piercing discarding sabot shots can penetrate the armor of nearly any tank.
Combining different kinds of new ammunition technology with guns with higher muzzle velocities, these anti-tank guns are prepared for whatever new armor our enemies may develop.

Rocket artillery is less accurate and has a much lower sustained rate of fire than batteries of traditional artillery guns. However, they have the capability of simultaneously hitting a target with multiple rockets with devastating effect.
Self-propelled artillery utilizing multiple rockets will be able to cause large-scale destruction rapidly, while maintaining mobility to avoid counter-fire.
Sacrificing range for impact, we can mount heavier rockets on larger vehicles. Operating in teams, these artillery batteries can cooperate to reload and relocate quickly.
Spin-stabilized rockets, increasing the range of lighter artillery batteries.
The mountainous terrain of Northern India led to the development of an artillery piece that could be dismantled and carried on muleback to wherever it was needed.

Known as "morale" in previous games, organization is the readiness of a division to perform combat, the willingness of a unit to either continue attacking or to continue holding the province that they are defending. Once a unit no longer has any organization remaining, it can no longer fight in battles. Infantry and mobile battalions tend to be the primary source of organization in a division, so it is important to buffer lower-organization battalions like tanks and combat support battalions with enough of them to keep the division combat-capable. Represents the room that the division takes up while fighting at the front line. In order to fit into battle, the division needs to fit into the combat width provided by the battlefield. The less width that each division takes, the more divisions that can fire upon the enemy at the same time. However, making many thin divisions also has its tradeoffs. Different battalion types increase the combat width of a division by a different amount. For example, infantry and armoured battalions use 2 width, artillery battalions use 3 width, and anti-tank and anti-air battalions use 1 width. We can reorganize our aviation industry to eliminate waste and streamline production.
By creating specialized advanced training units within each division, we can deploy even divisions that would previously have been held back to finish training to the front.

There is still a lot of slack in our construction industry. By focusing our attention on it, we can achieve a significant improvement in construction speed. Unfortunately, the production of machine tools has proven a major bottleneck in the expansion of our heavy industry, so they won't benefit from efforts in this area.
We will form specialized repair teams from factory and construction workers and centrally control their deployment to improve reconstruction of damaged infrastructure.
By focusing resources on our shipyards and exempting skilled shipbuilders from military service, we can dramatically reduce production time for ships.
By infiltrating the major resistance groups in occupied territory and turning their leaders, we can significantly reduce the amount of damage they can do.
By reorganizing our colonial bureaucracy and recruiting native administrators, we will, in time, be able to take charge of our own affairs.
Our colonial subjects have gotten rather silly ideas about things like "self-determination" or "national independence". It is time to disabuse them of these notions.
We will encourage our research institutes and universities to reach out to their counter parts in allied countries. This will gain us a tech sharing bonus.
Although we have lost land to the enemy, the fight must go on. The Black Lions are offering a great deal of resistance to the Italian's and we should therefore support them in any way we can.
Across Ethiopia there are patriots willing to take up arms against the Italian invaders. We must do everything we can to support these brave men and women in crippling the Italian war machine

The task of preparing the Swiss population is never-ending. We cannot rest until the threat of invasion is gone, and might never be. We must orient our nation towards defensive preparations without delay.
Our citizens are armed and deployed into their local militias, it is everyone else's duty to support them however they can so we can keep the enemies of the confederation at bay
We must do what we can to resist and undermine our Overlords to ensure Danish sovereignty.

Road to 56 was originally a released as a ‘mod pack’ in December of 2016 that contained Greatexperiments personal mods and some of the communities’ most popular country-specific mods at the time. It was operated from December 2016 till the Fall of 2018 as a ‘mod-pack.’ During this time Thinking_Waffle joined the development team, having previously developed a stand-alone country mod that was included in Road to 56. JudgeAlfred joined the mod team during this period as well. The mod would periodically update its content from the outside mods that comprised the mod pack and doing maintenance to make sure the content worked well together. This period of the mod’s life is known as ‘old-school’ or ‘legacy’ Road to 56. This is the period of time where the stigma’s of the mod being horrible unbalance and buggy took root because admittedly it was. Starting in the fall of 2018, the mod saw a large influx of new developers and artists who would help set the new course for the mod. As in the fall of 2018, the development team decided to stop updating the mod with outside content, and the last update that included content that was made outside the internal development team occurred in March 2019. From the fall of 2018 onward, the internal development team made new content in-house for the mod and work tirelessly to bring old content within the mod up to the communities’ high standards. This work has accumulated in Road to 56 becoming the most played Hearts of Iron 4 mod as well as the most subscribed to item on it’s the Hoi4 steam workshop. The hard work and hours spent on the mod was recognized when during PDXCON 2019 Thinking_Waffle stepped on stage to accept the 'Outstanding Modding Achievement' for the Road to 56 team.

The complexity of the games often warrants player collaboration over the forums. Often, players will assist other players with the games, post modifications, and write "after action reports". Due to much of the game content being in plain text and image files, the modification of the games has become very popular. Much of the gameplay information used by the engine is contained in uncompressed text and bitmap graphic files. The ability to freely edit these files has allowed an active modding community to develop.
